title: CORS Policy Blocked Request
description: Diagnose browser-blocked requests caused by cross-origin policy mismatches and preflight failures.
errorSignature: Access to fetch at ... has been blocked by CORS policy
symptoms: Requests fail in browser but succeed in Postman
OPTIONS preflight returns 403/404
Authenticated requests fail when credentials are enabled
causes: Missing or incorrect Access-Control-Allow-* headers
Origin whitelist mismatch across environments
Credentialed requests with wildcard CORS policy

fixSteps.title: Validate encoded request URL and origin target
fixSteps.description: Ensure URL and query parameters are formed correctly before server policy checks.

fixSteps.title: Normalize and review CORS/auth configuration payloads
fixSteps.description: Format middleware and policy JSON to make diff analysis deterministic.

fixSteps.title: Compare working and failing header/config snapshots
fixSteps.description: Use diff to isolate exact policy drift responsible for browser blocking.

title: Timestamp Timezone Mismatch In API Responses
description: Fix user-visible date/time inconsistencies caused by seconds-vs-milliseconds and timezone conversion drift.
errorSignature: Incorrect date/time rendering across regions or environments
symptoms: Different users see different event times
Session expiry appears early or late
Time filters return inconsistent records
causes: Mixing seconds and milliseconds formats
Converting timezone more than once
Server and client making conflicting assumptions about UTC

fixSteps.title: Convert and verify epoch values in both UTC and local time
fixSteps.description: Use a dedicated converter to confirm canonical interpretation of time values.

fixSteps.title: Format and inspect affected payload structures
fixSteps.description: Normalize payloads to reveal where timestamp transformations are applied.

fixSteps.title: Compare successful and failing payload snapshots
fixSteps.description: Diff payload revisions to isolate transformation drift between releases.

title: Fix JSON Parse Error: Unexpected Token
description: Resolve malformed JSON parsing failures by isolating invalid syntax, escaped values, and contract mismatches.
errorSignature: SyntaxError: Unexpected token ... in JSON at position ...
symptoms: Frontend crashes when parsing API payload
Data table or UI fails to render after network response
Errors appear only for specific customer or environment data
causes: Missing comma, quote, or closing bracket
Double-encoded JSON strings passed as objects
Invalid escape sequences or unsupported characters

fixSteps.title: Validate payload syntax and formatting
fixSteps.description: Paste raw payload into a strict formatter/validator to identify exact invalid segment.

fixSteps.title: Decode nested escaped values
fixSteps.description: If payload is stringified JSON, decode once and inspect the resulting object.

fixSteps.title: Compare working vs failing payload
fixSteps.description: Run side-by-side diff to isolate mismatch introduced by upstream system.

title: JWT Expired or Invalid Signature Troubleshooting
description: Troubleshoot token failures caused by expiration mismatch, malformed claims, algorithm drift, or signature handling issues.
errorSignature: jwt expired / invalid signature / token malformed
symptoms: Users are logged out unexpectedly
Authenticated APIs return 401 even with fresh login
Token works in one environment but fails in another
causes: Clock skew between issuer and verifier systems
Wrong signing key or algorithm mismatch
Corrupted token transport encoding

fixSteps.title: Decode token claims and verify exp/iat
fixSteps.description: Inspect timestamps and key claims to validate token lifecycle assumptions.

fixSteps.title: Inspect encoded token segments
fixSteps.description: Decode Base64 segments to confirm payload integrity and structure.

fixSteps.title: Diff auth config between environments
fixSteps.description: Compare auth middleware/config files to find secret, issuer, or algorithm drift.

title: Regex Not Matching Expected Inputs
description: Fix false positives and false negatives in regex validation through repeatable pattern testing and edge-case analysis.
errorSignature: Pattern matches wrong values or misses valid values
symptoms: Valid form inputs are rejected
Invalid strings pass validation unexpectedly
Behavior differs between browser/runtime versions
causes: Incorrect quantifier boundaries
Missing anchors (^, $) or wrong flags
Overly broad character classes

fixSteps.title: Run targeted pattern tests
fixSteps.description: Test pattern against representative valid and invalid inputs with match-group visibility.

fixSteps.title: Compare old and new regex versions
fixSteps.description: Diff pattern revisions to understand introduced behavior changes.

title: URL Encoding Breaking API Request
description: Diagnose and fix malformed API requests caused by incorrect URL encoding or double-encoded query parameters.
errorSignature: 400 Bad Request / malformed URL / signature mismatch
symptoms: API returns 400 for specific user inputs
Signed URLs fail verification
Spaces/special characters break endpoint behavior
causes: Encoding full URL instead of individual values
Double encoding upstream and client side
Decoding too early in middleware chain

fixSteps.title: Encode/decode target parameter values
fixSteps.description: Validate exact value-level encoding behavior before constructing final URL.

fixSteps.title: Diff working and failing request URLs
fixSteps.description: Compare complete request strings to identify exact corrupted segment.

title: Hash Mismatch After File Transfer
description: Investigate content integrity issues by comparing hash outputs and file deltas across transfer boundaries.
symptoms: Downloaded artifact fails integrity check
Deployment package differs from source artifact
Checksum verification scripts fail intermittently
causes: Transfer corruption or truncation
Wrong hashing algorithm used at one stage
Line-ending normalization changes file bytes

fixSteps.title: Generate hash outputs from both artifacts
fixSteps.description: Use same algorithm on both versions and confirm the mismatch deterministically.

fixSteps.title: Compare file contents to isolate changed bytes/lines
fixSteps.description: Use file diff to reveal exactly where artifact divergence occurred.
